libraries.source_policy: Teacher prior: the common development task descriptions, three reference RGB images and fixed capability goals only. No historical student code, execution, candidate, or full Blender GT is available.

Strategy-trajectory learning: the common development inputs plus all six E3 strategy-guided runs (three scenes, two repetitions), their actual guidance, source versions, tool events, student scene states and executed observations. No full Blender GT is available.

Exploration-trajectory learning: the common development inputs plus all six E4 exploration-guided runs (three scenes, two repetitions), their actual guidance, candidate source, executions, observations, comparisons and final decisions. No full Blender GT is available.

GT-guided learning: the common development inputs plus three complete development Blender GT scenes and their true structured data. Historical student code, execution and candidate results are not available.

GT plus exploration learning: exactly the same complete development GT as A4 and exactly the same six exploration runs and evidence types as A3. This additional information is the experimental variable; tool permissions and budgets are identical.
